purpose: Manual project-level zoning corrections used to prevent commercial geocoding anchors from overriding the ordinance zoning scope.
precedence_rule: Project-level zoning context does not modify the canonical 520 Productivo parcel membership. When a commercial pin conflicts with the known project zoning/location, the pin is treated as a marketing/map anchor and must not promote the project into the Productivo audit universe.

notes: Saint Henri is located behind the municipal farm / CEA / other areas mapped as Equipamiento, rather than on those Equipamiento parcels.
The Saint Henri development itself is identified as Uso Específico.

The commercial coordinate previously extracted at -34.8549898,-58.342622 falls on a Productivo parcel but must be treated as a misplaced/general commercial map anchor, not as evidence that the project is Productivo.
Exclude Saint Henri from the main Productivo numerator/denominator and from Productivo VHR targeting unless an independently verified project geometry intersects Productivo.
